scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @natacao/api" "npm run dev -w @natacao/web" "npm run dev:vision"
scripts.dev:vision: [ -x services/vision/.venv/bin/python ] && (cd services/vision && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8800) || echo '[vision] AquaVision ausente (sem .venv em services/vision) - a API usara o AquaMotion'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @natacao/domain && npm run build -w @natacao/api && npm run build -w @natacao/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @natacao/domain && npm run test -w @natacao/api && npm run test -w @natacao/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @natacao/domain && npm run typecheck -w @natacao/api && npm run typecheck -w @natacao/web
